instruction: Set the font of all text on this slide, including the table, to Arial and change the font color to green.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires selecting all text content (including table) and changing both font to Arial and color to green. The custom getter extracts font name and color of all text runs, and the metric verifies that all runs use Arial font and are green. Verified that the original presentation has text in both regular shapes and table cells that need formatting.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator checks both requirements (Arial font AND green color) for all text content
Correct state extraction: Getter reads all text runs from both regular shapes and table cells (lines 38-81 in getters/impress.py)
Correct comparison logic: Metric properly compares boolean flag from getter against expected value
Proper expected parameter handling: Metric correctly accesses expected.get('all_target_font_and_green') since expected IS the rules dict when type='rule'
Good postconfig: File is saved with Ctrl+S ensuring latest state is captured for verification
Edge case handling: Getter handles missing files and empty presentations appropriately
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Green color detection threshold (G>200, R<100, B<100) is quite strict and might reject some valid green colors with slightly higher R or B values. Consider slightly relaxing thresholds if false negatives occur (e.g., G>180, R<120, B<120).
